description: Implementation of error handling and reporting functions for the gn build system, including error message formatting, line highlighting, and error object management.

classes.name: Err
classes.description: Represents an error or warning, with methods for printing and managing sub-errors.

methods.name: GetNthLine
methods.description: Retrieves the Nth line from a string view of data.

methods.name: FillRangeOnLine
methods.description: Highlights a range within a specific line by replacing characters with '-'.

methods.name: OutputHighlighedPosition
methods.description: Outputs a line with highlighted error position markers.

methods.name: Err::Err
methods.description: Constructors for the Err class, initializing error details.

methods.name: Err::operator=
methods.description: Assignment operator for copying error objects.

methods.name: Err::PrintToStdout
methods.description: Prints the error message to stdout.

methods.name: Err::PrintNonfatalToStdout
methods.description: Prints a non-fatal warning message to stdout.

methods.name: Err::AppendSubErr
methods.description: Adds a sub-error to the current error.

methods.name: Err::InternalPrintToStdout
methods.description: Handles the detailed formatting and output of the error message.
